info.name: Nord Pool Data Portal API (Public) Auction Day-Ahead Prices API

params.name: market
params.description: Market to query. DayAhead is the day-ahead auction market.

params.name: deliveryArea
params.description: Comma-separated bidding/delivery area codes, for example NO2 or SE3,FI,DK1.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency for returned prices (EUR or a local currency such as NOK, SEK, DKK).

items.docs: Returns day-ahead auction prices for one or more delivery areas on a given CET delivery date, in 15-minute Market Time Unit entries plus per-area block-average aggregates and daily statistics. Verified live (HTTP 200 with price data) on 2026-07-11.

info.name: Day-ahead price indices by index name

params.name: market
params.description: Market to query. DayAhead is the day-ahead auction market.

params.name: indexNames
params.description: Comma-separated index names (typically area codes such as NO2 or SE3).

params.name: resolutionInMinutes
params.description: Index resolution in minutes (for example 15 or 60).

items.docs: Returns day-ahead price index values (area price indices at a chosen resolution) for a given CET delivery date. Verified live (HTTP 200) on 2026-07-11.
